title: 第 5 课 · 串联（series）
summary: 首尾相接：电流相同，电压相加，电阻相加。
concepts: KVL 基尔霍夫电压定律
description: 先看「拆开看」里的 **电阻**（左侧会自动打开）：色环、欧姆定律、额定功率。
**这一课学什么**：串联（series）——元件首尾相接、中间没有分岔，电流只有一条路可走。在面包板上：R1 的第二只脚和 R2 的第一只脚在同一条金属条上，而且这条金属条上没有接别的东西。
**串联的三条规律**
| 规律 | 公式 | 本课 |
| 电流处处相同 | I_R1 = I_R2 = I_LED = I | 同一个 I |
| 电压相加（KVL） | V电源 = V_R1 + V_R2 + V_LED | 每个元件“分走”一部分电压 |
**算一算**
- tests 会用电压表检查这两个值。
**用处**：两个电阻串联可以凑出手头没有的阻值（比如两个 220 Ω 当 440 Ω 用）。

en.title: Lesson 5 · Series circuits
en.summary: End to end: same current, voltages add up, resistances add up.
description: Look at the **Resistor** teardown first (it opens on the left): colour bands, Ohm's law, power rating.

**What you learn**: series — parts joined end to end with no branch in between, so the current has only one path. On the breadboard: R1's second lead and R2's first lead share a strip, and nothing else is plugged into that strip.
**Three rules of a series circuit**
| Rule | Formula | Here |
| the current is the same everywhere | I_R1 = I_R2 = I_LED = I | one I |
| resistances add | R_total = R1 + R2 | 220 + 220 = 440 Ω |
| voltages add (KVL) | V_supply = V_R1 + V_R2 + V_LED | each part takes a share of the voltage |
**Work it out**
- the drop on each 220 Ω: V = I × R ≈ 0.016 × 220 ≈ 3.5 V
- the tests check both values with a voltmeter.
**What it's good for**: two resistors in series make a value you don't have (two 220 Ω as 440 Ω).
steps: Battery + to tp1, − to tn1; red jumper tp3 → a3.
R2 goes in c7 – c11: its first lead and R1's second lead are both in column 7, connected end to end.
Red LED: long lead in d11, short lead in d14.
Blue jumper a14 → tn14 back to GND. There is only one path: + → R1 → R2 → LED → GND.
hints: The series connection point (column 7) may only hold the two leads of R1 and R2; nothing else can connect there.
tests: LED on; R1 and R2 each get about 3.5V

steps.text: 电池 + 接 tp1，− 接 tn1；红色跳线 tp3 → a3。
R2 插 c7 – c11：它的第一只脚和 R1 的第二只脚都在第 7 列，首尾相接。
红色 LED 长脚插 d11，短脚插 d14。
蓝色跳线 a14 → tn14 回到 GND。整条路只有一条：+ → R1 → R2 → LED → GND。

hints: 串联的连接点（第 7 列）上只能有 R1 和 R2 两只脚，不能再接别的东西。
